name: Vadh Se Bachaye Govansh Ko Sahayata Yojana
benefit:
- Financial assistance of ₹40/day for large cattle and ₹20/day for small cattle.
  - Support is provided for a maximum of one (1) year or the custody period, whichever is shorter.
_eligibility_text: - Registered Gaushalas/ Nandi Shalas/ Kanj Houses/ Local bodies/ Panchayati Raj institutions/Other approved institutions which are taking care of cows rescued from cow smuggling/ slaughter.
